rule.message:
Admission requirements include 45 credits, completed or in progress.
These courses are intended to be taken earlier in a student's career in the major, and would ideally be completed prior to a student's final academic year. Students must complete one course from each category. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

All students must complete the University's Liberal Education requirements .
Departmental Requirements:
The only course that can be taken S/N is OLPD 4696.
Collegiate Requirements:
All incoming CEHD Freshman must complete the First-Year Experience course.
At least 19 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
